_comment: WHAT THE BASEMAP HOLDS, measured 12 September 2026 against cached layers built from
EVERYTHING MEASURED BEFORE THIS DATE IS SUPERSEDED. The earlier runs returned named
lists cut at twelve alphabetically (D76), so a works whose name sorts late was
indistinguishable from a works nobody had drawn, and several used a FALLBACK CENTRE —
the parent city, or the village the benchmark's coordinate fell in — which searched
somewhere the owner never named and returned real industry that read as a miss.
Rotterdam city centre stood in for Europoort; Pieterburen for Eemshaven.
THE CENTRE IS NOW THE OWNER-NAMED PLACE OR THERE IS NO SWEEP. One place node: sweep.
None: the place is not in the basemap. Several: picking one would be a guess. The
centre itself is never written down; only the name of the place matched.
MACHINE FINDING AND HAND VERDICT BOTH RECORDED, and they disagree often. The commonest
disagreement is a SUBSTATION OR A RAILWAY NAMED AFTER A WORKS matching as the works.
EVERY LAYER CARRIES ITS EXTRACT'S BLOB COUNT AND BYTE TOTAL, computed by a walk of the
blob headers that decompresses nothing — the structural check that replaced a feature
count this register had invented about itself (D77).
method: sources/osm/layer.py, sources/osm/sweep.py, against dated Geofabrik extracts

results.owner_named: the Eems power plant site, Eemshaven
results.hand_note: Eemshaven is not a place node in the Groningen extract. The earlier run fell back to Pieterburen, the village the benchmark's coordinate falls in, 25 km away, and returned five named features that would have been recorded as the works not being drawn.
results.not_swept_because: the owner-named place is not a place node in this extract

results.owner_named: beside the Enecogen power station, Europoort
results.hand_verdict: a works is drawn, but the owner's sentence puts the plant beside it, not on it
results.hand_note: The host works is drawn under its own name, with its 380 kV substation. Eneco's release says the electrolyser 'will be developed NEXT TO the Enecogen power station' — adjacency, which the host-works rule does not cover. The earlier run centred this on Rotterdam city centre and found nothing.

results.owner_named: the Gewerbepark Prignitz-Falkenhagen
results.hand_note: Three place nodes in Brandenburg are called Falkenhagen. Picking one would be a guess, and a guess here produces a finding about somewhere else.
results.not_swept_because: 3 place nodes carry this name — picking one would be a guess

results.owner_named: the site of the decommissioned Lubmin nuclear power station
results.hand_verdict: only the estate that occupies the site is drawn, and an estate is refused
results.hand_note: What occupies the decommissioned nuclear station's ground is drawn as an industrial and technology PARK. Lhyfe names 'the site of a decommissioned nuclear power plant'; the estate polygon is refused as a position under the Subotica rule.

results.owner_named: four hectares of NPorts land at Wilhelmshaven
results.hand_note: 93 named industrial features within 6 km and not one is NPorts' four hectares.

results.owner_named: the former waterworks of the city of Wittenberg
results.hand_note: 30 named features and no waterworks, former or otherwise. SKW Piesteritz — the agro-chemical park VNG's release names as the neighbour opposite — is drawn, which places the neighbour and not the plant.

results.owner_named: land west of Pembroke Power Station
results.hand_verdict: a works is drawn, but the owner's sentence puts the plant beside it, not on it
results.hand_note: The power station is drawn under its own name. RWE's page says the plant is 'on RWE's site to the WEST OF Pembroke Power Station' — adjacency again. The earlier run, truncated, returned nine street cabinets carrying the word Substation and no station.

results.owner_named: the Montalieu-Vercieu cement plant
results.hand_verdict: the works the owner names is drawn and named
results.hand_note: Vicat's release: 'By installing a 330-MW electrolyzer AT the cement plant' at Montalieu-Vercieu. On the works, which the host-works rule admits. THE ONE DRAWING IN THE WHOLE SAMPLE.

results.owner_named: Kokkola, a municipality and no more
results.hand_note: Six place nodes are called Kokkola. The entry would not be swept under the municipality rule either: Plug Power names a municipality and no more.
results.not_swept_because: 6 place nodes carry this name — picking one would be a guess

results.owner_named: the Los Barrios coal-fired power station site
results.hand_note: Four place nodes are called Los Barrios.
results.not_swept_because: 4 place nodes carry this name — picking one would be a guess

results.owner_named: BAYERNOIL's refinery at Neustadt an der Donau and Vohburg
results.hand_verdict: a works is drawn, but the owner's sentence puts the plant beside it, not on it
results.hand_note: The refinery is drawn under its own name. BayH2's page says the 128 MW electrolyser 'deckt den H2-Bedarf der BAYERNOIL' — it supplies the refinery, and does not say it stands on it.

results.owner_named: Trafford Low Carbon Energy Park, Manchester Rd Carrington M31 4AY
results.hand_verdict: something named after the works is drawn; the works is not
results.hand_note: Carrington Power Station is drawn; the Trafford Low Carbon Energy Park that Carlton Power gives a postal address for is not. A different works on neighbouring ground.

results.owner_named: Tata Steel IJmuiden
results.hand_verdict: a works is drawn, but the owner's sentence puts the plant beside it, not on it
results.hand_note: Tata Steel's works is drawn. The IPCEI register names it as where the hydrogen is APPLIED — an offtake relation, not a statement about where the electrolyser stands.

results.owner_named: the Zeeland refinery at Nieuwdorp
results.hand_verdict: something named after the works is drawn; the works is not
results.hand_note: Two substations carry the refinery's name. The refinery itself is not among the 66 named features. A substation named after a works is not the works — the same trap as Pembroke's street cabinets.

results.owner_named: the Van Citters harbour, Vlissingen-Oost
results.hand_note: Vlissingen-Oost is not a place node in the Zeeland extract.
results.not_swept_because: the owner-named place is not a place node in this extract

results.owner_named: the former Sniace grounds at Torrelavega

Sniace: Estación Depuradora de Aguas Residuales de SNIACE [industrial]
Planta eléctrica de cogeneración de SNIACE [industrial]

results.hand_verdict: something named after the works is drawn; the works is not
results.what_matched: Estación Depuradora de Aguas Residuales de SNIACE [industrial]
results.hand_note: Two ancillary installations of SNIACE are drawn — its waste-water plant and its cogeneration substation — and the former factory grounds RIC Energy names are not drawn as anything. The site is partly mapped through its utilities.

results.owner_named: the port of Punta Langosteira
results.hand_verdict: something named after the works is drawn; the works is not
results.hand_note: What is drawn is the RAILWAY WORKS to the port, tagged construction. The port of Punta Langosteira itself is not among the 35 named features.

results.owner_named: Iso Järviluoto in the Port of Rauma
results.hand_note: 49 named features around Rauma and no Iso Järviluoto. The port extension the owner names is new ground.

results.owner_named: Kirrinsanta and Aittaluoto, Pori
results.hand_note: 23 named features around Aittaluoto, mostly substations, and neither Kirrinsanta nor Pori Energia's Bio-CHP plant among them.

results.owner_named: Pyyryväinen, Oulu
results.hand_note: Pyyryväinen is not a place node in the Finland extract.
results.not_swept_because: the owner-named place is not a place node in this extract

results.owner_named: Idomlund, near Holstebro
results.hand_verdict: something named after the works is drawn; the works is not
results.hand_note: The 400 kV substation Idomlund is known for is drawn. Ørsted's facility is not, and a substation is not a Power-to-X plant.

results.owner_named: Skipavika Havneterminal
results.hand_note: Skipavika is not a place node in the Norway extract. Fuella's own page names 'Skipavika Havneterminal' and gives no municipality — this register wrote Bremanger onto the candidate once, from no source, and corrected it.
results.not_swept_because: the owner-named place is not a place node in this extract

results.hand_note: Nesbruket is not a place node in the Norway extract, though Gen2 Energy names it and holds a building permit from Vefsn municipality for the works there.

results.owner_named: Monstad, Åfjord
results.hand_note: Monstad is a place node and the sweep ran: two named industrial features within 4 km, neither of them Gen2 Energy's.
